product.olivetti-m380-xp7.summary: The M380/XP variant with ten positions at the same clock speed as the XP4.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.history: The documentation places M380/XP7 as the M380/XP variant with ten positions at the same clock speed as the XP4.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA842 / BA829 / BA825. The board supports 4–8 MB and additional expansion uses memory boards.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records BA825 / BA829: 1.05 · PBU5/PBU4 / 1.07 · PBZ1/PBZ0.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-xp7.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 9-1–9-3.
